scope.runtime: Locally owned deterministic test environment; no production proof.
scope.realIex: Three native SPY PNG cases and three separate historical inspection cases use the admitted 302-report/26,121-share envelope c8f3acd1390bffa145441cb95dedbc5e3dafcbe08deed3a4c11691155b2b5b8b.
scope.shell: Surrounding quote, watchlist and research-card values in whole-application screenshots are unrelated deterministic fixtures, not the IEX archive.
scope.marketEvidence: Historical, venue-only, partial session. Archive acquired after exchange events; original decision-time availability is not proven.
scope.responseEvidence: No qualified real quote response or tick metadata; real absorption and out-of-sample efficacy remain unproven.
scope.overlap: Dense markers and numeric labels can overlap, especially on mobile. Inspection preserves exact execution quantities.
scope.attachmentValidation: All included JSON parses and all PNG signatures checked; bounded literal scan found no absolute private workspace paths or selected credential patterns. Independent visual review is explicitly scoped.
scope.excludes: Raw market archive, private native sidecars, traces, complete environment-bearing test reports, hosted CI, deployment, live feed, CME/MNQ entitlements, distinct-order counts and predictive claims.
